subject: k-pop fans
one_liner: Video meetings for opinions that require a quorum.
brand_voice_notes: Treat fandom as a regulated deliberative body. Specific administrative consequences, sincere delivery, fictional artists only. No winking or breathless tech claims.

hero.h1: Your bias needs a board meeting.
hero.sub: Bias gives k-pop fan clubs video rooms, AI scream-to-minutes and binding comeback votes. Six people. Forty opinions. One approved eight-second clip.

features.title: Scream-to-minutes
features.blurb: AI records a sustained E-flat as “broad support.” Every emotional peak receives an action owner.

features.title: Bias-based breakout rooms
features.blurb: Separate members by favourite performer. Reunite them only after each room has appointed a neutral chair, usually the same person.

features.title: Binding comeback votes
features.blurb: Approve a clip with four of six votes. All abstentions remain in the permanent record, including yours.

demo_screen_concept: A mock six-seat NOVA7 comeback committee video room, with designed camera-off typographic seat tiles, a three-motion agenda and a binding vote panel. Select each motion, cast or change your vote, watch the majority update from 3 to 4 of 6 approvals, mute your mic, switch your camera placeholder on, and add a scream to AI minutes. All simulated locally. The Unofficial observer preview keeps the agenda and record read-only, disables ballots and omits scream-to-minutes; its sixth seat is nonvoting. Voting previews update your participant tile for the active motion, including changed votes and reset.

design_direction.style: Pop fan-club stationery with inflated rounded typography and offset ticket-shaped fields. Bright pink paper, deep concert-blue ink and mint voting slips. Flat screenprinted art; generous rounded cutouts rather than SaaS cards.

palette.name: Fan Mail Pink and Ballot Blue

design_direction.archetype: Community/Forum Landing from the bundled library: broad community pitch, large campaign art, open feature strips, a designed voting explainer, member quotations and membership options.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 150ms colour response, vote bar width changes in 200ms. No ambient motion. Reduced motion removes transitions.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Left-aligned broad rounded headline sits in a pink field above the CTA. Below, a wide blue ticket announces committee membership beside the Gemini campaign composition. Open text rows and a large infographic carry the lower page. A scalloped-edge impression is reserved for the art, not every panel. Demo is a dense two-column call room with six tiles and an agenda.
design_direction.design_review: Read the latest seven concepts in full for direction and branding. No full tuple matches. Rejected automatic OLED because it would repeat the recent dark call-room treatment. Library Playful Creative pairing and custom pink-paper palette support fan mail rather than concert photography. Logo and illustration family replace recent photo-led mastheads. No decorative numbered features.

brand_kit.identity_rationale: Converts the concert lightstick into a deliberative microphone: fandom volume meets meeting control. The original icon and rounded custom Bias lettering support screenprinted fan-club graphics. Unlike the recent photographic entries, identity is carried by composed two-colour illustration and ticket typography.

logo.concept: Gemini-designed rounded Bias wordmark beside a concert lightstick/meeting microphone, crowned by five speech forms. Primary, navy monochrome and cropped symbol variants preserve the accepted design.
logo.clear_space: At least half the symbol width on every side; baked into exports.
logo.placement: Landing nav and footer; demo chrome; icon favicon on both pages

graphic_language.medium: Flat screenprinted pop editorial illustration with intentional oversized rounded typography
graphic_language.motif: Lightstick microphone; six voting lightsticks used specifically in the voting artwork
graphic_language.composition: Asymmetric big typography and one dominant illustrated object; two inks on pink, broad quiet margins, no photo collage
graphic_language.texture: Very light ink grain inside artwork only; CSS surfaces flat

images.rationale: Reserve four successful calls for two logo directions and two composed artworks. No photography needed: the demo uses honest camera-off placeholders. Deterministic exports preserve the accepted logo.

items.prompt: Design a finished original brand logo for Bias, a fictional video meeting product for k-pop fan clubs that vote on eight-second comeback clips. Actual usable horizontal logo, no presentation board, no mockup, no slogans, no source-company trademarks. Exact and only text: "Bias". Flat background #FCE5EE, deep blue #192B75 and pink #C51D65 only. Broad clear space. Left symbol occupies left quarter; wordmark on the right, full silhouette never cropped. Direction A: a bold concert lightstick that is also a meeting microphone, six chunky rounded speech lobes forming its crown, short tilted handle. Bespoke confident rounded lower-case lettering after capital B, optical kerning, strong compact silhouette, graphic designer quality. No hearts, stars, sparkles, badges or geometric app squares. Symbol must remain identifiable at 32px. Use solid flat inks, no shadows, no checkerboard.
items.placement: Landing nav and footer; demo chrome
items.verdict: Selected A: exact Bias spelling, confident kerning and lightstick-microphone silhouette. B has a more generic interlocked chat shape. A is distinctive at navigation size and its isolated symbol reads at 32px; tiny speech tips simplify at icon scale. Five speech forms accepted; no six-count claim made for logo.

items.prompt: Create an art-directed landscape campaign poster for Bias, video meetings for k-pop fan clubs. Attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE; use its exact custom Bias logo and microphone-lightstick silhouette without changing letterforms. Palette pink paper #FCE5EE, navy #192B75, deep pink #C51D65, mint #9BE7D8. Flat screenprinted editorial illustration, slight ink grain. A giant meeting microphone/lightstick becomes a podium surrounded by six small illustrated voting hands holding fan placards. Elegant asymmetric composition: oversized rounded typographic block on left, sculptural lightstick and hands on right; integrated pink ballot scraps, broad margins. Design layout, typography, illustration and hierarchy as one finished composition, no photos or rendered UI. Exact copy only: "Eight seconds." then "Subject to approval." Small label "Bias" only if using approved wordmark. No extra text, no watermark, no decorative stars or hearts. Keep every word clear at 600px display and all essential type large. True graphic design, not a plain background.
items.verdict: Accepted: exact headline and approval line, integrated six voting hands, bespoke lightstick podium and faithful logo. Two-colour hierarchy reads at desktop and mobile; no photography substitution.

items.prompt: Create an art-directed illustrated infographic for Bias, a fan-club video voting product. Attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE; preserve the approved logo language and microphone-lightstick geometry. Flat pop screenprint on #FCE5EE with #192B75, #C51D65 and #9BE7D8; tiny ink grain. Purpose: show exactly six seats and a four-vote approval threshold. Compose SIX bold lightsticks in a wide shallow fan or semicircle, exactly FOUR filled navy and TWO outlined navy with pink handles. Fan base is a large mint ballot tray. A bold large rounded headline above: "4 of 6" and below it "makes it official." Small integrated legend with exact words "4 approve" and "2 abstain". No other text except small approved Bias wordmark if appropriate. Typography and numbers exceptionally legible, broad margins. Not a simple arrow flowchart, not a photo, not software UI; build a polished data-story illustration with strong information hierarchy and beautifully arranged voting objects. Quantities must be exactly six total, four filled, two outlined.
items.verdict: Accepted: 6 numbered lightsticks, exactly 4 filled and 2 outlined. Correct 4 of 6 headline and 4 approve / 2 abstain legend. Faithful icon and palette. Minor added seat numbers are meaningful and correct. Fine legend is supplemented with live HTML on mobile.
